rosetta.releaseStatus: candidate commit only; tagged and certified release required

codex.status: development candidate; live credential non-exposure proof required

scanner.observationWindow: scanner-owned UTC RFC3339 interval within the evidence run
scanner.inputCommitment: sha256 of four-byte big-endian length-prefixed UTF-8 domain, run ID, surface, resource kind, resource name, then the 32-byte input sha256
scanner.status: commitment-only scanner verified; live harness required

collector.sourceContract: one-shot io.ReadCloser acquired from a run-owned live resource
collector.status: collection boundary verified; run-bound acquisition adapter required

evidenceRun.profileOwnership: checked profile snapshot and dataground-openshell-canary/1.0.0 verifier identity
evidenceRun.serialization: sealed until collection and every cleanup succeeds

workspaceCleanup.name: dg-canary-<runID>
workspaceCleanup.status: workspace lifecycle verified; live harness wiring required

evidenceRun.status: run, all source lifecycle, and cleanup adapters verified; live Docker execution required

sandboxCleanup.resource: exact DataGround execution returned by the OpenShell provider
sandboxCleanup.verification: terminate then require a timestamped exact terminal observation
sandboxCleanup.status: sandbox cleanup adapter verified; live harness wiring required

providerCleanup.name: dg-canary-provider-<runID>
providerCleanup.resource: exact OpenShell provider ID, name, resource version, isolation domain, and gateway
providerCleanup.verification: observe exact binding, delete, then require timestamped absence
providerCleanup.exclusivity: dedicated evidence gateway with no concurrent provider mutation
providerCleanup.status: provider cleanup adapter verified; live harness wiring required

sourceAcquisition.binding: exact evidence run, canary commitment, and portable gateway, sandbox, provider, and runtime names
sourceAcquisition.sourcePorts: typed OpenShell, Docker, and runtime streams
sourceAcquisition.handoff: single-use canonical collection with direct scanner handoff

openShell.binding: exact persisted execution, private native sandbox, and gateway endpoint
openShell.transport: streaming pinned OpenShell sandbox exec argument vectors without a shell
openShell.status: OpenShell sandbox source backend verified; live Docker execution required

docker.binding: exact running gateway container ID, digest-pinned image, Compose project and service, and run, gateway, and provider evidence labels
docker.transport: streaming Docker inspect argument vectors and complete timestamped stdout and stderr logs without a shell
docker.status: Docker host source backend verified; live harness required

runtime.binding: same exact execution.RuntimeSession passed to the native runtime adapter, evidence run, and portable runtime name
runtime.capture: bounded in-memory capture of complete native stderr before one scanner handoff
runtime.zeroization: captured bytes cleared after scanner close, unusable handoff, or explicit discard
runtime.status: runtime-error source backend verified; live Docker execution required

sourceAcquisition.status: all seven source backends verified; live Docker execution required

runtime.transport: openshell sandbox exec without a TTY

schemaEvidence.canonicalization: recursive object-key ordering followed by compact JSON serialization without a trailing newline
